text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One month later— 
The day of the 'Beauty Dream Cup.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Adorned in their Racewear, the Muses 
awaited the start of the race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A black dyed by nothing else... 
Curren-chan, it's so very "cute."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much♪ 
Your cuteness shines right through too, 
Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren was really looking forward to this 
debut race. 
Because I can finally show everyone the 
universe's cutest Curren.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it's time for our match. 
Wearing this Racing Dress, there's no way 
I'd give anything less than my all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, now I have even more to look forward 
to in this race. 
Even so, Curren is definitely, absolutely 
not gonna lose♪"
"Whoa! Look, look, this is so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Even when I hop up and down, it feels 
totally fine! 
With this Racewear, I can run tons and 
tons!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, its elasticity, durability, range 
of motion—everything is magnificent no 
matter where you look. 
And... this design is..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"It's so pretty... 
Looking at this Racewear makes me feel so 
happy."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... what everyone watching the 
race will think...?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Ufufu, it seems my little Muses love my 
Racewear too☆"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Only you Muses can captivate everyone 
with the très bien brilliance of that 
Racewear! So—"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Show them your all! Show everyone your 
ultimate Beauty at the 'Beauty Dream 
Cup'!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Rounding the fourth corner, the Muses 
clad in their beautiful Racewear are now 
charging through the final stretch!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Gooaaal! What a spectacular run by all 
five Muses! 
Deafening cheers are echoing throughout 
the venue!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*... *pant*... I lost! 
But that was so, so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Fun... Yes, indeed. It allows for such 
effortless movement that I even felt 
compelled to run beyond my limits."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone~, how did you like Curren's 
Racewear?♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: CUTE CURREN CHAN!!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I thank you all for your passionate 
cheers. 
It has truly become an unforgettable 
race."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Curren-san and Fine-san are both so 
amazing...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (But... what about Rice...?)

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan, your dress is so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower! That was a great race, thank 
you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Did they just say Rice's name...? 
They called me cute... and said thank 
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is smiling... They look so 
happy... 
Because Rice and everyone... because the 
Muses ran...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... Rice was able to become one 
too...! 
The Muse I always looked up to, who brings 
smiles to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, inside the Beauty Dream 
Cup Collaboration Café—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Amazing~! The parfaits and the cakes are 
all super cute, aren't they? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They made them in the image of our 
racewear. 
How lovely, this will make for such a 
wonderful memory! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
They're all so cute, I can't decide! 
Which one should I get~? Maybe I'll just 
order all of them~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I understand your enthusiasm, but you 
should practice some restraint. 
It would be quite problematic if you could 
no longer fit into the racewear we were so 
graciously given.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Urara-chan, Ikuno-san. If you'd 
like, 
would you share with Rice? Rice can't 
choose either, so...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, in that case, please count me in as 
well. 
Getting to share a meal with everyone is 
such a precious opportunity, after all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If we're all sharing, let's just order one 
of everything! 
Once the cakes arrive, I want us to take 
pictures together too, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I bet people would love it if we posted it 
on Umastagram. 
As for what tags we should use, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#AfterPartyWithEveryone #BeautyCollabCafe 
#SpecialSweets #And #CuteMuses"! ♪
